Class SegmentDrawing

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.SegmentDef

Provides static methods for drawing line segments and collections of segments with various styles, thicknesses, and effects.

Remarks

This class contains extension methods for Segment and Segments to simplify drawing operations.

Fields

MinSegmentDrawLength

Minimum length (in world units) that a segment must have to be drawn. Segments with a squared length less than ShapeEngine.Geometry.SegmentDef.SegmentDrawing.MinSegmentDrawLengthSquared are skipped to avoid rendering extremely short or degenerate geometry that can cause visual artifacts or unnecessary draw calls.

public static readonly float MinSegmentDrawLength

DrawMasked(Segment, Circle, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of segment that are masked by the provided mask circle.

public static void DrawMasked(this Segment segment, Circle mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false)

Parameters

segment Segment

The segment to be drawn or clipped against the circle.

mask Circle

Circle used as a closed mask for clipping the segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the circle (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the circle.

Remarks

Intersection computations are delegated to IntersectCircle(Circle). Handles cases where both endpoints are inside, both outside with two intersections, a single intersection, or no intersections.

DrawMasked(Segment, Polygon, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of segment that are masked by the provided mask polygon.

public static void DrawMasked(this Segment segment, Polygon mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false)

Parameters

segment Segment

The segment to be drawn or clipped against the polygon.

mask Polygon

Polygon used as a closed mask for clipping the segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the polygon (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the polygon.

Remarks

Intersection computations are delegated to IntersectPolygon(Polygon, int). Handles cases where there are zero, one, or multiple intersection points. When multiple intersections are returned, the method augments the intersection list with the segment endpoints and sorts them to determine alternating inside/outside intervals before drawing the appropriate subsegments.

DrawMasked(Segment, Triangle, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of segment that are masked by the provided mask triangle.

public static void DrawMasked(this Segment segment, Triangle mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false)

Parameters

segment Segment

The segment to be drawn or clipped against the triangle.

mask Triangle

Triangle used as a closed mask for clipping the segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the triangle (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the triangle.

Remarks

This method handles the following cases:

  • Both endpoints inside the triangle (draws whole segment when reversedMask is true).
  • Both endpoints outside with two intersection points (draws subsegments determined by intersections).
  • Single intersection point (draws the appropriate subsegment depending on which endpoint is inside).
  • No intersections (draws whole segment when outside and reversedMask is false). Intersection computations are delegated to IntersectTriangle(Triangle).

DrawMasked<T>(Segment, T, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of segment that are masked by a generic closed-shape mask. This generic overload dispatches to the concrete shape-specific overload (Circle, Triangle, Quad, Rect, or Polygon) based on mask.GetClosedShapeType().

public static void DrawMasked<T>(this Segment segment, T mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false) where T : IClosedShapeTypeProvider

Parameters

segment Segment

The segment to be drawn or clipped against the mask.

mask T

The mask shape that provides its closed-shape type. The method will attempt to cast to the concrete shape type.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the mask (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the mask.

Type Parameters

T

A type that implements IClosedShapeTypeProvider and represents the mask shape.

Remarks

If the concrete mask type is not one of the supported closed shapes, no drawing occurs. Use the concrete overloads when the exact mask type is known to avoid the runtime dispatch and cast.
